description: Get full details for one product by id, including description, specs, stock and VAT-included localized price. When the product is NOT in stock the record carries substitutes[]: up to 5 in-stock products of the same kind in the same price band (the same alternatives the product page shows), each as a brief record with its own product_id, price and product_url - offer them instead of searching. Every record also carries companions[]: up to 8 in-stock accessories used together with this product, one per role (role is a short label such as stand, cable, strings, case; other = no specific role) - the list our add-to-cart box shows, chosen from what customers buy together and checked with AI - each as a brief record with its own product_id, price and product_url; when the customer asks what else they need or decides to buy, offer these first (empty = we have no accessory list). Products with a stored buying guide also carry buying_guide: who the product suits (audience.levels are fixed English tokens: beginner, intermediate, professional, child, teacher, gift), typical use cases, plain-language explanations of terms, questions and answers (the last one, when present, lists the accessories of companions[]), and - while the product is in stock - a spec-based comparison with up to 3 in-stock alternatives (each with its own product_id, price and product_url). The guide is Romanian for language=ro and English otherwise; it was written with AI from our product data and a sourced fact sheet.

language.description: Locale for text + pricing. Default ro.
